# Licendi

> Licendi is a software license marketplace specializing in Microsoft Office and Windows operating system licenses at competitive prices.

Licendi offers a comprehensive catalog of Microsoft productivity software including Office 2019-2024 editions, Microsoft 365 subscriptions, and Windows operating system licenses. The platform provides both standalone applications and bundled suites for individual, business, and enterprise users.

## Key Topics

- Microsoft Office
- Microsoft 365
- Windows 11
- Windows 10
- Office Professional Plus
- Office Standard
- Office Home & Business

- Microsoft Visio
- Software Licensing
- License Marketplace
- Office 2024
- Office 2021
- Enterprise LTSC

## Microsoft Office Licenses

- [Microsoft Office Licenses](https://licendi.com/en/microsoft-office-licenses): Microsoft Office licenses catalog with Microsoft 365 and Office versions
- [Buy Microsoft 365](https://licendi.com/en/microsoft-office-licenses/office-365): Microsoft 365 and Office 365 subscriptions with Teams and Copilot
- [Buy Office Professional Plus](https://licendi.com/en/microsoft-office-licenses/professional-plus): Office Professional Plus editions (2010-2024) product page
- [Buy Office Standard](https://licendi.com/en/microsoft-office-licenses/standards): Office Standard editions (2013-2024) product catalog
- [Buy Microsoft Office Home & Business](https://licendi.com/en/microsoft-office-licenses/home-business): Office Home & Business editions for Windows and Mac
- [Buy Microsoft Office Home & Student](https://licendi.com/en/microsoft-office-licenses/home-student): Office Home & Student editions for students and home users
- [Buy Word, Excel, PowerPoint](https://licendi.com/en/microsoft-office-licenses/word-excel-etc): Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook standalone licenses catalog
- [Buy Office Apps](https://licendi.com/en/microsoft-office-licenses/office-apps): Individual Office apps: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams licenses

## Specialized Microsoft Software

- [Buy Microsoft Access](https://licendi.com/en/microsoft-office-licenses/access): Microsoft Access database software licenses (2016-2021)
- [Buy Microsoft Project](https://licendi.com/en/microsoft-office-licenses/project): Microsoft Project Professional project management software licenses
- [Buy Microsoft Visio](https://licendi.com/en/microsoft-office-licenses/visio): Microsoft Visio Professional diagramming software licenses

## Windows Operating System Licenses

- [Windows Licenses](https://licendi.com/en/windows-licenses): Windows operating system licenses: Windows 10, 11 editions
- [Buy Windows 11](https://licendi.com/en/windows-licenses/windows-11): Windows 11 editions including Enterprise LTSC and IoT versions
